Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: C01-CH06-S29 最后誓约逐一确认. One new finished full-bleed opaque 16:9 game narrative scene, native wide landscape preferably 1672×941. No border or text.
Input roles: Image1 is approved chunky matte game art: broad clear planes, big expressive heads and hands, stout figures, economical contours. Image2 is the exact named Mirelle identity: brown hair in a bun, mature warm light face, cream scarf/hood, navy charcoal robe, brown belt/pouches, brass gravekeeper lantern and simple stamping tools. Preserve her face and clothing identity, not her pose or background. Image3 is approved wide scene simplification and group-figure readability only; do not copy its forge.
Story meaning: At the Bone Army Tower, the returned dead are asked separately whether to return, what task they choose, whether to rest afterward, and whether to authorize political representation. Each answer may differ. Mirelle has put down her purification seal so every returned person can refuse her. A one-use flag token expires after that person's chosen goal. This is careful individual confirmation, not an army oath, recruitment rally or magic command.
Scene: an open gray-brown wartime cemetery clearing in cool plain daylight. A few broad weathered grave slabs and earth banks, a distant squat broken ring of stacked burial stones suggesting the bone tower, small subdued broken flag poles but NO flying flags. Ground is spare big matte shapes, not thousands of cobbles. A central public memorial is a plain broad upright slab with abstract shallow lines, no readable lettering, no hero statue.
Main composition: closer three-quarter view, camera just above eye level of the short chunky figures, full bodies clear. At the image center a small simple wooden registrar table stands before the memorial. An open large cream ledger rests flat on it, clearly divided into FOUR simple columns across one visible spread, with a few short abstract marks, no readable writing. Mirelle stands immediately on the left side of the table around x43%, listening attentively to ONE autonomous returned adult on the right around x56%. Mirelle's calm open left palm is low and inviting; her other hand rests near the ledger, not pointing at a person. Her lantern stands at the table leg, its tiny warm light confined to the housing. The returned person wears plain worn slate-blue soldier clothing without a helmet covering the face, has ordinary human eyes and skin subdued by desaturation, and points to one entry while holding a single SMALL muted ocher cloth flag-token with a short loose cord in the other hand. The cord attaches to nothing else. Both faces and both hands are large and distinct; their poses read as an equal one-to-one conversation, neither kneels.
Mirelle's separate brass square-ended purification stamp lies unused sideways on a low stone shelf at the foot of the public memorial behind the ledger, clearly detached from her hands and belt. It is an ordinary stamp with short handle, not a wand.
Three additional distinct returned human adults in the middle ground remain visibly separate. Left: an older woman in simple faded brown civilian clothing walks away along an unobstructed path, looking back with a low open palm of polite refusal; no one stops her. Right: an apron-wearing adult carries one plain folded bandage bundle toward an exit, choosing aid work. Farther back: a cloaked gray-haired person sits quietly beside an individual grave, choosing rest, hands relaxed, no ceremonial kneeling. Their lower cloak hems have just a few clean missing sections or separated quiet gray cloth wisps to suggest memory echoes, not floating monsters. Human faces, dignified distinct desires, natural varied poses and orientations. No unified circle, no formation, no shared gesture. The central named woman and returned person are the largest figures; others clearly supporting. Keep all heads, hands, feet and key objects fully inside the authored composition with sensible margins. Tightly group the central interaction within the middle third so a narrow portrait crop still sees conversation and ledger; the full wide scene must show the different choices.
Style: bold chunky matte tactical-fantasy cartoon, strong clean dark outer contours, large solid color shapes with only 2–3 painted tone planes, expressive enlarged heads and hands, short sturdy limbs, broad stone slabs and smooth ground. Muted slate gray, clay brown, cream paper and navy robe, tiny brass accents. Fully painted opaque setting. Quiet urgency and patient respect, no triumphant mood.
Avoid: grain, stippling, dense etched details, fine dirt noise, gritty texture, photorealism, glossy 3D, bloom/fog overlays, tiny pebbles, skeleton faces, skulls, glowing evil eyes, bones, undead horde, translucent alpha scene, single spectral boss, giant unified body, military ranks, synchronized saluting or kneeling, raised weapons, binding beams, command rings, chains, crown, giant altar, dramatic magic, text, labels, UI, watermark. No extra named characters. Original legacy ceremonial-circle slot is a known semantic mismatch and is not a content reference.
